note: Audited realignSelectedBlock, _realignRectangle and realign-region.js's mafftAlign usage. Null results are handled correctly (returns cancelled:true with original seqs; both callers return before any pushUndo, so no stray undo step and no other edit's step popped). Undo steps are pushed after the await (26298 / 26367), which is safe because state.seqs is not touched between the call and the validated result (only local copies are mutated in realign-region.js). Exceptions from the aligner also leave no undo step. One low-severity defect: on a staleness discard, callers show a misleading second toast ('Block realign cancelled.' / 'Region realign cancelled.') on top of the correct staleness message.
